requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2511-4550-5567-8298--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
2511-4550-5567-8298--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1385-4279-5075--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1385-4279-5075--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat, Ogre Slumlord and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2024-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with different powers.

1978-3263-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with different powers.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4574-6972-8095.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
4574-6972-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Arcbound Reclaimer.
When Arcbound Reclaimer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Reclaimer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Reclaimer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an artifact card in your graveyard.
If needed, hold priority and repeat step 1 until Arcbound Reclaimer dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When Arcbound Reclaimer dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it due to its modular ability.
Holding priority, repeat from step 1.

1011-2511-2728-6854.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2511-2728-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2511-2728-6854.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

2034-4558-7494-7520.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Goblin Glasswright, adding {C}{C}.
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying {2}{R} and unpreparing Blazing Firesinger.
When you cast that spell, Extus triggers, returning Goblin Glasswright from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Cast Goblin Glasswright by paying {1}{R}.
Goblin Glasswright enters prepared.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Blazing Firesinger, adding {C}{C}.
Cast a copy of Craft with Pride from exile by paying {R} and unpreparing Goblin Glasswright.
When you cast that spell, Extus triggers, returning Blazing Firesinger from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Craft with Pride, creating a Treasure token.
Cast Blazing Firesinger by paying {2}{R}.
Blazing Firesinger enters prepared.
Repeat from step 2.

738-2034-7707-7882.easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls a nontoken creature.
738-2034-7707-7882.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Roadkill Rodney, adding {C}{C}.
When Roadkill Rodney dies, The Serpent Society triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a nontoken creature they control.
When a creature dies this way, Glissa triggers, returning Roadkill Rodney from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Roadkill Rodney by paying {2}.
Repeat as able.
738-2034-7707-7882.notes: You can repeat this lock during each of your turns so long as an opponent controls a nontoken creature.

2092-4954-4974.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Zendikar Resurgent triggers, adding {1}.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping the land and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.
2092-4954-4974.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

1894-5220-5332-6900.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Carmen trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1129-1379-1978.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Allies.
1129-1379-1978.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Harabaz Druid.
Repeat

500-1181-3277.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Izzet Chronarch and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Izzet Chronarch tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Sacrifice from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing a Izzet Chronarch token, adding an amount of {B} equal to its mana value. 
Repeat.

4186-5445-6798.easyPrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Scurry Oak.
4186-5445-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
4186-5445-6798.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Squirrel.
When the Squirrel dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

292-3693-6774.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-3693-6774.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

957-2061-2556.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Stretch each other turn.
957-2061-2556.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall.
When the Mnemonic Wall token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

997-3542-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}.
997-3542-5140.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Palinchron from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Palinchron, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

186-1283-4929-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's second ability by paying {1}, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
186-1283-4929-5140.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

108-1270-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Eyeless Watcher.
When Eyeless Watcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating six 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

186-236-4131.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
186-236-4131.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Cast Bring to Life by paying {2}{U}, making Basalt Monolith a 0/0 artifact creature and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

803-2290-4384.notablePrerequisites:
Spike Feeder has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
"Halfling" or "Treefolk" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-2290-4384.description:
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to gain two life.
Treebeard triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Spike Feeder.
Repeat.
Once Spike Feeder has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may target any other creature with Treebeard's ability.

2634-2997-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}.
2634-2997-4276.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Turnabout.
Resolve the copy of Turnabout, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.
